title: docs(skills,spec): what a package skill does in the in-app ask assistant; trigger context is client-sent
body:
Fixes #37002

Delivers the card's items 1, 2 and 3. Item 4, the lint warning, is not built, and the card does not require it: its text is "Optional, only if the allow-set constant is published in spec by then", the acceptance list does not name it, and no allow-set constant is published in `packages/spec` on `main`.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Landing: this diff touches `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**`, Tier H surfaces, so the maintainer merges it. The card says to land it only after objectstack-ai/cloud#4985 has merged. That gate is met: the cloud seat's confirmation on the card (comment 7163165666) records the merge on 2026-11-25 09:32Z as `d2c498192`. This session cannot read that repository; the reading is the cloud seat's.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:给应用写 AI 技能的作者和替他们写的 AI,在技能文档和协议参考页里读到实情:应用自带的技能在应用内问数助手里随所在应用生效、清单之外的工具会被丢弃并给出提示、触发条件能读哪几项界面信息,以及这些信息由界面上报、只能用来分流、不能当权限。
- 为什么做:替给应用写技能的作者解决——应用内问数助手的行为已经定下,发布给他们的说明还是旧说法。
- 出错会怎样:只动说明文字和一条评测的期望描述;写错了作者会学到错的做法,撤回这次合并即可恢复原文。
- 要你做什么:含受管面(技能文档和两份决策记录各一行指针),由你手工合并。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, *Trigger Conditions*: one new paragraph on the in-app `ask` assistant, marked as a cloud surface. Its four statements are the card's:
  - a package skill with `surface` `ask` or `both` loads for the app the user is in, and the `build` side is not served while in-app build is closed;
  - a tool the skill names outside the allow-set is dropped with a diagnostic;
  - a condition can read `appName`, `objectName`, `recordId`, `selectionKind` and `userRole`;
  - the client sends all five, so a condition on any of them, `userRole` included, is routing, never access control: the turn's tools still run under the caller's own permissions.
- The same file, three deletions that pay for part of the paragraph. Each one restates text the file keeps:
  - under *Skill Configuration*: "A **Skill** is a named bundle of tools with dedicated instructions and trigger conditions." The diagram above it and the two tables below it say the same.
  - under *Platform agents*: "You extend the platform with **skills**, never by adding an agent." The frontmatter description and the "Skills are your entry point" paragraph say the same.
  - under the built-in skills table, three clauses of the open-edition sentence: "All four are cloud-runtime skills", "authored for cloud", and "their `instructions` are what MCP serves". The edition note at the top and the `instructions` row say the same. The sentence keeps its three facts: none of the built-ins is available on the open edition, `surface` and `triggerConditions` are inert there, and `tools` binds nothing there but is read.
- `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, eval 5: the last sentence of `expected_output` was "The runtime's `ask` / `build` agents pick the skill up by surface." It is now "The in-app `ask` assistant picks the skill up by surface (`ask` or `both`) for the app the user is in, and a tool the skill names outside the allow-set is dropped with a diagnostic." `prompt`, `must_contain` and `must_not_contain` are unchanged.
- `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts`: the `.describe()` of `triggerConditions` gains one sentence: "The context fields a condition reads are reported by the client: a condition is routing, never access control". Nothing else in the file changes.
- `content/docs/references/ai/skill.mdx`: regenerated with `gen:docs`. The one `triggerConditions` row moves. No other generated artifact was stale, and the JSON schemas are git-ignored.
- `docs/adr/0063-two-kernel-agents-skills-are-the-extension-primitive.md` and `docs/adr/0064-tool-scoping-to-agent.md`: one add-only header line each, under `**Consumers**`. Both name the cloud record as `cloud ADR-0118`, by its title "App-package skills load on `ask`; their tools are intersected with an allow-set", with a link to its file on cloud `main`. ADR-0063's line says the record implements §2 of that ADR on `ask`; ADR-0064's line says it records the allow-set an app-package skill's tools are intersected with on `ask`. No existing line changes, neither line makes a status claim, and `docs/adr/README.md` stays current (`adr-index --check` exit 0).
- `.changeset/37002-ask-skill-text.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/skills` and `@objectstack/spec`.

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the new paragraph. Every clause is a cloud fact taken from the card body. None of them was checked against cloud code from this session.
2. The same file's three deletions. Check that each is a restatement and that the open-edition sentence still says what it said.
3. The two ADR lines. Check the record's number, title and file against the cloud record: they are copied from the cloud seat's confirmation, not read from cloud.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md is 6801 tokens (ceiling 6801; headroom 0)` and exits 0.

## Skill size readings

Head f3015126fc5 against base dfdebfadd58. The readings are those of 7425db8698c: the later commit changes two ADR files only.

| Reading | Before | After |
|:---|---:|---:|
| `SKILL.md` lines | 464 | 467 |
| `SKILL.md` bytes | 26968 | 27221 |
| `SKILL.md` tokens (ceiling 6801) | 6737 | 6801 |
| all 14 `SKILL.md` files, lines | 4937 | 4940 |
| all 14 `SKILL.md` files, tokens | 65303 | 65367 |
| whole shipped tree, tokens | 296856 | 296948 |
| eval file tokens (measured, not ratcheted) | 2112 | 2140 |

The paragraph adds 509 bytes and the three deletions remove 256, a net of 253 bytes or 64 tokens. That spends the file's whole headroom (64 to 0). No ceiling moves, and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not edited.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`, under the verify lock, at 7425db8698c: `Test Files  891 passed (891)`, `Tests  28371 passed | 1 todo (28372)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The same suite gave the same counts one commit earlier, at 20ede3dc441. It was not run again at f3015126fc5: that commit changes two ADR files, and no test under `packages/` names either.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, under the verify lock, at 20ede3dc441: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The later commit changes `SKILL.md` and the changeset only, which no `tsc` program reads.
- No ablation. The diff changes prose, one description string and one generated page, and no behaviour a test pins.
- Importers of `@objectstack/spec` owe no test here: the public surface is byte-identical apart from one description string, and `check:api-surface` is green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Eval 5, the acceptance case: measured FAIL at one repetition; the baseline is NOT MEASURED (quota).** One round of `skill-evals --skills objectstack-ai` ran at head 20ede3dc441: 16 of 16 turns, 8 cases on both arms, one repetition, 6.5 minutes. With-skill scored 5 of 8 and no-skill 0 of 8. The three with-skill misses:
  - eval 5 lacks `aiExposed`, and its forbidden `knowledge:` matched inside a code comment that reads `search_knowledge: platform knowledge tool.` The answer did refuse the agent and write a `surface: 'ask'` skill.
  - eval 4: its forbidden `handler:` matched inside a comment that reads "It has no handler:". The answer also authors a tool record, which the expected answer does not.
  - eval 7 says "Never retry the call" where the required token is `do not retry`.

  None of the three is on a token this diff touches: `aiExposed`, `knowledge:`, `handler:` and `do not retry` appear on no added or removed line. Eval 5's assertions are unchanged; only its `expected_output` moved. Evals 1, 2, 3, 6 and 8 pass with the skill. No baseline round ran on `main`'s text, so this round cannot say whether eval 5 passed before this change: the login's seven-day window read 0.84 at the first turn and 0.85 at the last, status `allowed_warning`, and the seat ruled that no baseline runs for this PR. Whether the card's acceptance line needs a measured pass is the maintainer's call at hand-off.
- The round ran one commit before the final head. The final commit moved the skill text in two ways, and both leave more teaching in the file than the measured text had: it restored the blueprint row's "agents are platform-supplied, and `tools` is not the default path", which the measured text had cut, and it shortened the new paragraph by 14 bytes of wording ("In the in-app" to "In-app", "any of them" to "any"). The row was restored because eval 4's miss is in the area that clause repeats.
- One deletion sits in a section eval 5 leans on: "You extend the platform with **skills**, never by adding an agent." The file still says it in the frontmatter description, in "Skills are your entry point", and in the retired `agent.tools` row. Without a baseline its effect on eval 5 is not measured.
- The cloud record the two ADR lines point at: the cloud seat's confirmation gives `cloud ADR-0118`, file `docs/adr/0118-app-package-skills-on-ask-tool-allow-set.md`, on cloud `main` as `e738843ba`, and says its own status line still reads "Proposed (2026-11-24)". The two lines here name the record and say nothing about its status.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally: it exits 3 until every dual-build package in the workspace has a `dist/`, which is a whole-workspace build this diff does not owe. CI runs it.
- The card names the allow-set and does not list its members or say where the diagnostic appears, so the skill names it without listing it. An author cannot yet check a tool against it before running. The card's item 4 would answer that once the constant is published in the spec.
- The values `selectionKind` takes and what `appName` holds are given in card comment 7152100136, not in the card body. The dispatch limited cloud facts to the body, so the skill names the five fields and says no more about them.
- `skill.zod.ts` keeps two comments this card does not reach: the one above `field` gives `'channel'` as an example context field, which is not among the five the card names, and the one above `triggerConditions` says "object name, user role, etc.". The card limits the spec edit to the description string.
- The skill's sentence "An agent's tool set is the union of its surface-compatible skills' tools" is left as written. The new paragraph is where the allow-set is stated.
- The forbidden tokens of evals 4 and 5 match inside comments of otherwise acceptable answers, and eval 7 requires one wording of an instruction. Those fixtures are not changed here: they are outside this card.

## Verification

Two local readings, one per push.

- At 7425db8698c, before the ADR lines: the 114 commands `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived for the diff, 113 exit 0 and 1 exit 3. `--ran` reconciliation: `114 derived, 113 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- At f3015126fc5, the head: the 21 commands the two ADR paths derive, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation over those paths: `21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. The whole-diff derivation on this head is 115 commands: the 114 above plus `pnpm check:adr-index`, which is among the 21. The other 94 were not run again on this head. `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and `pnpm check:role-word` were, and both exit 0.

The whole list was then run again at 7425db8698c, which is the first reading above.
